name: fdl-benchmark-HaluEval
description: fdl-benchmark-HaluEval assesses hallucination and factuality in language model outputs by presenting prompts with reference facts and annotated labels indicating hallucinated content. It is intended to measure how often models produce unsupported or fabricated statements and to evaluate mitigation strategies. The benchmark is oriented toward binary factuality judgments and targeted hallucination detection.
reputation: A focused benchmark in hallucination research with interest among alignment and evaluation researchers but not a broadly established standard.
